errata.orig: When the PAC receives the Outgoing-Call-Reply, it attempts to connect the call, assuming the calling party has not hung up.
errata.correct: When the PAC receives the Incoming-Call-Reply, it attempts to connect the call, assuming the calling party has not hung up.
errata.notes: The PAC does not receive Outgoing-Call-Reply messages, as also indicated in sections 3.2.4.1 and 3.2.4.2. It receives Incoming-Call-Reply messages, as indicated in sections 3.2.3.1 and 3.2.3.2.
